stem.text: The graph shows how the length of a spring varies with the force applied to it.

stem.alt: Graph of force against length: the vertical axis is labelled force with F marked, the horizontal axis is labelled length with L0 and L1 marked; a straight line starts at L0 and rises to F at L1, with dashed guide lines to F and L1.

stem.text: The spring has unstretched length $L_0$. When a force $F$ is applied, the spring has length $L_1$.
What is the work done in stretching the spring to length $L_1$?
